items.briefing:
Two alleged members of the hacking group "TeamPCP" have been arrested in Australia, a reminder that cybercrime carries real legal consequences locally. Separately, clothing brand Carhartt suffered a data breach affecting nearly 13 million accounts — if you or your colleagues have an account, consider changing your password. July also saw record ransomware attacks globally, with AI increasingly being used by criminals to assist these efforts.

A Reco study found that four in five AI tools used in workplaces lack proper IT oversight, which is a growing concern for organisations. **Practical tip:** Before using any AI tool for work tasks, check with your IT team that it's approved — unauthorised tools can expose sensitive data.
